sections.challenge: The manual process of entering Bill of Materials (BOM) data from PDFs and images into the SQL database was extremely time-consuming and prone to human error. A single document took an average of 8 minutes (5-6 minutes for data entry and 1-2 minutes for verification), limiting productivity to only 6-7 documents per hour.
sections.solution: We designed and implemented an AI-powered OCR system to automate the data extraction process through a multi-stage pipeline consisting of three main components: Table Detection using object detection models to identify and isolate table structures across multiple formats, Data Extraction utilizing PaddleOCR for text recognition, PaddleStructure for structural analysis, and Docling PDF Extractor for PDF parsing, and Data Validation powered by the Qwen2.5-VL-32B model to validate accuracy, reconstruct complete tables, and ensure data consistency.
sections.impact: This automated pipeline significantly reduced the time required for data processing and increased overall productivity. The time per document was cut down to just 1-2 minutes, boosting the workload from 6-7 PDFs per hour to 15 PDFs per hour. In the future, we aim to further improve the pipeline's accuracy to enable direct data integration into the database.

sections.solution: Developed IT-PORTAL using Docusaurus, a modern React-based static site generator, providing a comprehensive knowledge management platform with organized sections for IT Management, IT Development, and Data Management, featuring full-text search capabilities, responsive mobile design, Markdown/MDX support, automated deployment pipelines, integrated content submission forms, and built with modern web technologies including React, TailwindCSS, and Playwright for end-to-end testing.

sections.challenge: The organization faced critical security and compliance challenges with Microsoft 365 Standard including weak account protection without MFA leaving accounts vulnerable to unauthorized access, unencrypted notebooks exposing sensitive data to theft risks, missing Intune, DLP, and Defender capabilities limiting threat protection, elevated security risks for critical users (Managers, Finance, Purchase, Sales, IT), and licensing limitations preventing compliance with cybersecurity and data protection standards.
sections.solution: A comprehensive security enhancement program was implemented in multiple phases: enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and conditional access policies across all user accounts, deploying BitLocker encryption on all notebooks and workstations for full-disk protection, upgrading 70 key users from Microsoft 365 Standard to Premium focusing on high-risk groups, activating Microsoft Intune for centralized device and policy management, implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect sensitive information, deploying Microsoft Defender for advanced threat protection, and conducting security awareness training for all users on best practices and compliance requirements.
sections.impact: The security enhancement project delivered significant improvements including all accounts secured with MFA dramatically reducing unauthorized access risks, BitLocker encryption safeguarding sensitive endpoint data from theft and breaches, advanced Defender capabilities protecting against malware, ransomware, and phishing attacks, strengthened compliance posture meeting cybersecurity and data protection standards, centralized management through Intune ensuring consistent security policies, enhanced logging and monitoring for audit requirements, overall cyber risk significantly decreased across the organization, minimized potential for security incidents and business disruption, and increased employee awareness and confidence in security practices.

sections.challenge: The Battery Production team handles planning, production, and delivery through manual processing to monitor available raw materials, stock, production, inventory, and shipping, using an ERP tool with additional Query processing in SQL Database and Excel for manual data calculation. This manual process takes a long time to summarize information and uses a large amount of paper (9,604 sheets per year), creating a tedious workflow that could be automated with a reporting dashboard to make data representations easier to understand.
sections.solution: The solution consists of three major components including data migration to move data from on-premises to the cloud environment, data pipelines to process and curate the data, and visualization reports to show curated data insightfully according to business needs, fully leveraging the AWS cloud service stack to ensure seamless integration and scalability.
sections.impact: Migrating data from on-premise to the cloud and adopting AWS QuickSight brought significant benefits by reducing manual summary time around 10 minutes per person, enabling scalable high-performance data storage and analytics, providing faster access to insights through self-service interactive dashboards with seamless integration into AWS services such as Redshift and S3, allowing business users to benefit from single source data, collaborative analytics and built-in machine learning for forecasting and anomaly detection, reducing IT teams' time spent managing BI infrastructure, and improving efficiency, agility, accessibility while enhancing security, compliance, and long-term scalability.

sections.challenge: The Kaizen suggestion and improvement tracking process was manual and paper-based, creating significant inefficiencies. The process took a long time to summarize information and consumed a large amount of paper with total usage of 9,604 sheets per year. This manual approach made it difficult to track improvement project status, delayed approval workflows, and lacked a centralized system to manage employee submissions and track implementation progress across the organization.
sections.solution: Developed an online Kaizen submission system that replaced paper forms with web input, integrated approval workflow including pre-approval before Kaizen Team, and centralized all Kaizen documents in a single digital platform, providing streamlined submission, tracking, and approval processes with clear workflow steps to reduce errors and delays.
sections.impact: The online system enables faster Kaizen submission and approval, completely eliminated paper usage achieving a fully digital workflow (0 sheets per year), created a centralized platform that improves tracking and accessibility, and established clear approval steps that reduce errors and delays, resulting in employees spending only 5 minutes per person per month to fill forms, supervisor approval completed within 1 hour, and data summarization reduced to 0.16 hours per person per month.
